description: The figurative constant ZERO (ZEROS, ZEROES) WITH the ALL phrase where the literal is restricted to a numeric literal - the VALUE clause of a numeric item and a level-88 VALUE under a numeric conditional variable (13.18.63.3 SR2: 'all literals in the VALUE clause shall be numeric'), and an arithmetic-expression operand (8.8.1.1). ISO §2023:8.3.3.6.3 SR1 a): 'the only figurative constant permitted is ZERO (ZEROS, ZEROES) without the ALL phrase'. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.1 reads 'If the literal is restricted to a numeric literal, the only figurative constant permitted is ZERO (ZEROS, ZEROES).', with no word about ALL, and SRL3.3 'When a figurative constant other than ALL literal is used, the word ALL is redundant and is used for readability only.', so the VALUE ALL ZEROS that CCVS-85 writes on PIC 999 (NC201A/NC211A/NC250A) is legal COBOL-85; §2002:8.3.1.2.5.2 SR1a adds the bar, 'the only figurative constant permitted is ZERO (ZEROS, ZEROES) without the ALL phrase', and §2014:8.3.1.2.5.2 SR1a prints it word for word (VCR Table 7 row 7.28). Under --permissive a warning, the value ZERO. One gate: FigurativeAssociation.GateAllZeroAsNumeric (kb/Work PB1415); askers DataBinder.ValidateValueCategory and ExpressionBinder (the arithmetic operand).
display: the figurative constant ALL ZERO where the literal is restricted to a numeric literal

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VALLZ.
DATA DIVISION.

01 W-INT PIC 9(3) VALUE ALL ZEROS.
